name: SpriteFlipMode
meaning: Last argument of Sprite_Draw (0x53a7f7) and AnimSprite_Draw (0x53b67e); both implement the identical switch. Selects a permutation of the four screen corners and a rotation index 0..3 applied to the four UV pairs. Value set {0,1,2,3,4,8,0xC} read from the switch cases in 0x53a7f7 (verified). The rotation cases pivot about the quad CENTRE: the divisor at 0x574320 is 2.0f (exe bytes 00 00 00 40), so they are rotations, not diamonds built from the rect midpoints.

name: SPRFLIP_ROT90
meaning: quad rotated 90 degrees about its centre, UV rotation index 1. Handedness (CW vs CCW on a y-down screen) not checked.

name: SPRFLIP_UV_ROT180
meaning: UV rotation index 2 only - the geometry is identical to SPRFLIP_NONE (case 2 sets only the UV index), so this is a 180-degree rotation of the texture within a fixed quad

name: SPRFLIP_ROT270
meaning: quad rotated about its centre the opposite way from mode 1, UV rotation index 3
